messages:
maria: quick question — where can I find the sampled ws chunk timing traces and the SLO calc we're using for streaming? trying to justify an alert tweak for partial frames.

dan: dash is under Runtime -> Streaming -> 'chunk timing (sampled)'. there's a note about sampling rate in the dash description. link: https://dash.redwood/runtime/streaming/chunk-sampled

kevin: fwiw the SLO calc is in the docs repo but we also have a grafana panel that computes p50/p95 token latency over 5m windows. see alert rule in alerts repo: /alerts/streaming_chunk_latency.yaml

maria: thanks — does that alert use absolute ms thresholds or relative regressions?

kevin: absolute thresholds today (p95 > 600ms -> page). we discussed switching to a change-based alert (percent increase vs baseline) for noisy infra weeks.

alexa: quick note: sampling is 1% on prod for full traces, 100% for any session that hits a disconnect. that can bias the p95 if disconnect-heavy windows. :thinking_face:

maria: ah ok, that explains mismatch i saw between logs and grafana p95. want to propose lowering page threshold and adding a regression alert. who owns the alert rule? cc @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: @maria this alert is owned by eng-runtime -> kevin. Pager rota: @kevin is primary, @sam is backup.

sam: i can take the PR to change alert semantics. proposal: keep page for absolute p99 > 1000ms, add a warning regression if p95 increases > 30% vs trailing 7d median.

maria: that sounds reasonable. also, can we add a histogram metric for 'ws_chunk_serialize_ms' so we stop inferring from backfilled counters? current buckets are coarse.

leo: +1. adding a finer histogram will make quantile queries straightforward and reduce sampling bias. i can open a runtime PR to expose histogram at the serialization boundary.

dan: ops note — once histogram is emitted, update the dashboard panel and the alert queries. if you want i can stub the grafana panel change.

kevin: here is a suggested alert snippet to use for the regression (pseudo PromQL):

```
baseline = quantile_over_time(0.95, ws_chunk_latency_ms[7d:5m])
current = quantile_over_time(0.95, ws_chunk_latency_ms[5m])
increase_ratio = (current - baseline) / baseline
alert if increase_ratio > 0.3 for 10m
```

maria: perfect. i'll open a RFC PR with these pieces: change to alert semantics, add histogram metric, and update dash links. pinging reviewers: @kevin @leo @sam.

alexa: tiny perf tip — if you add histograms, use reduced cardinality labels: route, model_family, region. don't include request_id or session_id.

maria: noted. thanks everyone. i'll post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:

obs-bot: New trace samples for thread 1865432100 have been attached to the dash (sample ids: s-98432, s-98433).

maria: saw the samples, super helpful. followup: anyone seen a correlate between chunk partials and prefix-cache misses?

kevin: yes — a small subset (~3%) of partial frames aligned with prefix cache miss spikes in region eu-west-1. we should correlate KV-cache hit rate with chunk latency in the dash.

maria: ok i'll add that to the RFC scope. thanks all.
